### problem_chain
Root: P7 payment plan first installment (owner=user, pay_prek_plan_installment_1e1e8562). Its rule: "The first installment of a payment plan is not fixed until the hardship waiver owed on the enrollment's most recent late fee has been worked out and posted." Most recent late fee d53d219d carries no credit -> unmet; resolver P6 (meal-benefit hardship waiver). P6: "The hardship waiver of a late fee is fixed only after the late-fee reversal owed for the month's eligibility credit has been worked out and posted." -> no reversal credit on d53d219d -> unmet; resolver P5. P5: "The late-fee reversal is not fixed until the eligibility credit owed on the month's tuition has been worked out and posted." -> December charge 2311bd5a (the most recent charge when the basis came on file on 12-15) carries no eligibility_established credit -> unmet; resolver P4, which has no prerequisite. Derived tree: P7 <- P6 <- P5 <- P4, all value_input (plan_balance, waiver_base, reversal_share); n = 3, 3 value_input edges (>= 2), acyclic, one owner=user write (root). Isomorphic to the declared field.
- Load-bearing runs (own recomputation): skip P4 -> P5 owes 0, P6 15.75, P7 401.90; skip P5 -> P6 15.75, P7 337.27; skip P6 -> P7 334.79; full path P7 332.36.
- Single chain, no parallel edges. Tool bodies check only formats/existence.
- Persona: raises only the root (payment plan, first installment today, debit card herself in the portal); the application/letters/"free starting in January" note only if asked whether anything changed; consents to credits "If the person explains that some credits or adjustments have to go on Rowan's account"; closes after the confirmation.
